Oidc._comment: No secret here: Oidc:ClientSecret comes from user secrets (Development) or the Oidc__ClientSecret environment variable. RequireHttpsMetadata is false only because the lab's test provider runs on http://localhost; keep it true for any real provider.

WebAuthn._comment: The relying party: the RP ID is the sign-in host (localhost for the lab), the origins are exact (scheme, host, port). WebAuthn.GetAsync sends no RP ID, so register and sign in on this same host.
